12
Maria de ngohwan sra Yesu
(Mateo 26.6-13; Marko 14.3-9)
1 # Yoh 11.1; 11.43 Afei, aka nnansia na Twam no aduru no, Yesu baa Betania, faako a Lasaro a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no wɔ. 2Ɛnna wɔtoo no pono wɔ hɔ, na Marta somee; na Lasaro deɛ, na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔne no te adidiiɛ no mu baako. 3#Luk 7.38 Ɛnna Maria faa ngo hwamhwam kronkron a ne boɔ yɛ den kariboɔ baako de bɛsraa Yesu nan ho, na ɔde ne tirinwi pepaa ne nan ho; na ngo no hwam yɛɛ ɛdan no mu ma. 4Ɛnna n’asuafoɔ no mu baako, Yuda Iskariot (a ɔrebɛyi no ama no), kaa sɛ: 5Adɛn nti na wɔantɔn ngo hwamhwam yi annye denare ahasa, na wɔamfa amma ahiafoɔ? 6#Luk 8.3 Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔdwene ahiafoɔ ho nti na ɔkaa yei, na mmom ɔyɛ owifoɔ, na ɔkura kotokuo no, na ɔwiawia deɛ wɔde gu mu ntira. 7Ɛnna Yesu kaa sɛ: Monnyaa no, na ɔde yei asie ama me sie da. 8#Deut 15.11 Na ahiafoɔ deɛ, mowɔ wɔn mo nkyɛn daa; na me deɛ, monni me daa.
Wɔtu agyina sɛ wɔbɛkum Lasaro
9Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no mu nkurɔfokuo pii tee sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na wɔbae, ɛnyɛ Yesu nko ara ntira, na mmom sɛ wɔbɛhunu Lasaro a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no nso ntira. 10Na asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no tuu agyina sɛ wɔbɛkum Lasaro nso, 11ɛfiri sɛ ne nti na Yudafoɔ mu pii kɔeɛ, kɔgyee Yesu diiɛ.
Yesu hyɛne Yerusalem nkonimdie mu
(Mateo 21.1-11; Marko 11.1-10; Luka 19.29-40)
12Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, nkurɔfokuo pii a wɔbaa afahyɛ no aseɛ tee sɛ Yesu reba Yerusalem no, 13#Dwom 118.25-26 wɔfefaa berɛ, na wɔfirii adi sɛ wɔrekɔhyia no, na wɔteateaa mu sɛ:
Hosiana!
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔreba Awurade din mu no,
Israel hene no!
14 # Sak 9.9 Na Yesu hunuu afunumu ba bi no, ɔtenaa ne so, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
15Nsuro, Sion babaa;
hwɛ, wo hene reba,
ɔte afunumu ba so.
16Nso n’asuafoɔ no anhunu yeinom kane no; na Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Yesu animuonyam akyiri no, ɛno na wɔkaee sɛ wɔatwerɛ yeinom ne ho, na wɔayɛ ama no. 17Ɛnna nkurɔfokuo a wɔne no wɔ hɔ berɛ a ɔfrɛɛ Lasaro firii adakamena mu na ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no dii adanseɛ. 18Yei nti nso na nkurɔfokuo no kɔhyiaa no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔate sɛ wayɛ saa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no. 19#Yoh 11.48 Ɛnna Farisifoɔ no kaa no wɔn mu sɛ: Mohunu sɛ montumi nyɛ ho hwee; hwɛ, wiase atu di n’akyi.
Helafoɔ bi pɛ sɛ wɔhunu Yesu
20Na Helafoɔ bi wɔ wɔn a wɔbaa sɛ wɔrebɛsɔre afahyɛ no ase no mu; 21#Yoh 1.45 ɛnna wɔbaa Filipo a ɔfiri Betsaida a ɛwɔ Galilea no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Owura, yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhunu Yesu. 22Filipo ba bɛka kyerɛɛ Andrea, na afei Andrea ne Filipo bɛka kyerɛɛ Yesu. 23Na Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Dɔn no aduru sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ Onipa Ba no animuonyam. 24#Rom 14.9 Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, ayuo baako antɔ fam anwu a, ɛwɔ hɔ korɔ no ara; na sɛ ɛwu a, ɛso aba pii. 25#Mat 10.39; Luk 17.33 Deɛ ɔdɔ ne kra no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa; na deɛ ɔtane ne kra wɔ wiase ha yi no, ɔbɛkora no akɔ daa nkwa mu. 26#Yoh 14.3; 17.24 Sɛ obi som me a, ma no nni m’akyi, na faako a mewɔ no, ɛhɔ na me somfoɔ nso bɛba; na sɛ obi som me a, m’Agya bɛdi no ni.
Yesu ka ne wuo ho asɛm
27 # Mat 26.38 Afei me kra ho yera no; na ɛdeɛn na menka? Agya, gye me firi dɔn yi mu! Nanso yei nti na mebaa dɔn yi mu. 28Agya, hyɛ wo din animuonyam! Ɛnna ɛnne bi firi soro baeɛ: Mahyɛ no animuonyam dada, na mɛhyɛ no bio. 29Ɛnna nkurɔfokuo a wɔgyina hɔ na wɔteeɛ no kaa sɛ: Aprannaa abom! Ebinom se: Ɔbɔfoɔ ne no kasae. 30#Yoh 11.42 Yesu bua kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me nti na ɛnne yi baeɛ, na mo ntira. 31#Yoh 14.30; 16.11; Luk 10.18 Afei ne wiase atemmuo; afei na wɔbɛyi wiase sodifoɔ no hɔ. 32#Yoh 8.28 Na me deɛ, sɛ wɔma me so firi asase so a, mɛtwe nnipa nyinaa maba me nkyɛn. 33Yei deɛ, ɔka de kyerɛɛ owu ko a ɔrebɛwuo. 34#Dwom 110.4; Dan 7.14 Nkurɔfokuo no buaa no sɛ: Yɛn deɛ, yɛate no mmara no mu sɛ, Kristo no te hɔ daa; na adɛn na wose: Ɛtwa sɛ wɔma Onipa Ba no soɔ? Hwan ne Onipa Ba yi? 35#Yoh 8.12; 11.10 Ɛnna Yesu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Aka hann no berɛ tiaa bi wɔ mo mu. Mowɔ hann no yi, monnante, na esum ammɛto mo; na deɛ ɔnam sum mu no nnim faako a ɔrekorɔ. 36#Efe 5.8 Mowɔ hann no yi, monnye hann no nni, na moayɛ hann no mma.
Nkurɔfoɔ no ntumi nnye nni
Yesu kaa yeinom, na ɔfiri wɔn anim hɔ kɔhuntaeɛ. 37Na wayɛ saa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bebree wɔ wɔn anim deɛ, nanso wɔannye no anni, 38#Yes 53.1; Rom 10.16 na Odiyifoɔ Yesaia asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no aba mu sɛ:
Awurade, hwan na wagye yɛn kaseɛ adie,
na hwan na wɔyii Awurade basa kyerɛɛ no?
39 # Yes 6.9-10; Mat 13.14-15 Yei nti na wɔantumi annye annie, sɛdeɛ Yesaia kaa bio sɛ:
40Wafira wɔn ani,
na wapirim wɔn akoma,
na wɔamfa wɔn ani anhunu,
na wɔamfa wɔn akoma ante aseɛ, na wɔannane wɔn ho
na mansa wɔn yadeɛ.
41 # Yes 6.1 Yesaia kaa yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhunuu n’animuonyam, na ne ho asɛm na ɔkaeɛ. 42#Yoh 9.22 Na mpanimfoɔ no mu pii nso gyee no diiɛ; nanso Farisifoɔ no nti wɔanka, na wɔantu wɔn amfiri hyiadan mu; 43#Yoh 5.44 ɛfiri sɛ na wɔpɛ nnipa animuonyam sene Nyankopɔn animuonyam.
Yesu nkyerɛkyerɛ tɔfa bɔ
44Na Yesu teaa mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔgye me die no, ɛnyɛ me na ɔgye me die, na ɛyɛ deɛ ɔsomaa me no; 45#Yoh 14.9 na deɛ ɔhu me no, hunu deɛ ɔsomaa me no. 46#Yoh 12.35 Maba wiase sɛ hann, na obiara a ɔgye me die no antena sum mu. 47#Yoh 3.17; Luk 9.56 Na sɛ obi te me nsɛm na wannye anni a, me deɛ, memmu no atɛn; na mamma sɛ merebɛbu wiase atɛn, na mebaa sɛ merebɛgye wiase. 48Deɛ ɔmmu me, na ɔnnye me nsɛm no wɔ deɛ ɔbu no atɛn; asɛm a maka no, ɛno ara na ɛbɛbu no atɛn ɛda a ɛdi akyire no mu, 49ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ ɛnyɛ me na mehyɛɛ me ho mekasaeɛ, na Agya a ɔsomaa me no na ɔhyɛɛ me deɛ menka ne sɛdeɛ menkasa. 50Na menim sɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ no yɛ daa nkwa. Enti deɛ meka no, sɛdeɛ Agya no aka akyerɛ me no, saa ara na meka.

Afei, aka nnansia na Twam no aduru no, Yesu baa Betania, faako a Lasaro a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no wɔ. Ɛnna wɔtoo no pono wɔ hɔ, na Marta somee; na Lasaro deɛ, na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔne no te adidiiɛ no mu baako. Ɛnna Maria faa ngo hwamhwam kronkron a ne boɔ yɛ den kariboɔ baako de bɛsraa Yesu nan ho, na ɔde ne tirinwi pepaa ne nan ho; na ngo no hwam yɛɛ ɛdan no mu ma. Ɛnna n’asuafoɔ no mu baako, Yuda Iskariot (a ɔrebɛyi no ama no), kaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na wɔantɔn ngo hwamhwam yi annye denare ahasa, na wɔamfa amma ahiafoɔ? Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔdwene ahiafoɔ ho nti na ɔkaa yei, na mmom ɔyɛ owifoɔ, na ɔkura kotokuo no, na ɔwiawia deɛ wɔde gu mu ntira. Ɛnna Yesu kaa sɛ: Monnyaa no, na ɔde yei asie ama me sie da. Na ahiafoɔ deɛ, mowɔ wɔn mo nkyɛn daa; na me deɛ, monni me daa.

Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no mu nkurɔfokuo pii tee sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na wɔbae, ɛnyɛ Yesu nko ara ntira, na mmom sɛ wɔbɛhunu Lasaro a ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no nso ntira. Na asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ no tuu agyina sɛ wɔbɛkum Lasaro nso, ɛfiri sɛ ne nti na Yudafoɔ mu pii kɔeɛ, kɔgyee Yesu diiɛ.


Adeɛ kyeeɛ no, nkurɔfokuo pii a wɔbaa afahyɛ no aseɛ tee sɛ Yesu reba Yerusalem no, wɔfefaa berɛ, na wɔfirii adi sɛ wɔrekɔhyia no, na wɔteateaa mu sɛ:
Hosiana!
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔreba Awurade din mu no,
Israel hene no!
Na Yesu hunuu afunumu ba bi no, ɔtenaa ne so, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Nsuro, Sion babaa;
hwɛ, wo hene reba,
ɔte afunumu ba so.
Nso n’asuafoɔ no anhunu yeinom kane no; na Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Yesu animuonyam akyiri no, ɛno na wɔkaee sɛ wɔatwerɛ yeinom ne ho, na wɔayɛ ama no. Ɛnna nkurɔfokuo a wɔne no wɔ hɔ berɛ a ɔfrɛɛ Lasaro firii adakamena mu na ɔnyanee no firii awufoɔ mu no dii adanseɛ. Yei nti nso na nkurɔfokuo no kɔhyiaa no, ɛfiri sɛ wɔate sɛ wayɛ saa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ no. Ɛnna Farisifoɔ no kaa no wɔn mu sɛ: Mohunu sɛ montumi nyɛ ho hwee; hwɛ, wiase atu di n’akyi.

Na Helafoɔ bi wɔ wɔn a wɔbaa sɛ wɔrebɛsɔre afahyɛ no ase no mu; ɛnna wɔbaa Filipo a ɔfiri Betsaida a ɛwɔ Galilea no nkyɛn, na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Owura, yɛpɛ sɛ yɛhunu Yesu. Filipo ba bɛka kyerɛɛ Andrea, na afei Andrea ne Filipo bɛka kyerɛɛ Yesu. Na Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Dɔn no aduru sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ Onipa Ba no animuonyam. Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, ayuo baako antɔ fam anwu a, ɛwɔ hɔ korɔ no ara; na sɛ ɛwu a, ɛso aba pii. Deɛ ɔdɔ ne kra no, ɛbɛfiri ne nsa; na deɛ ɔtane ne kra wɔ wiase ha yi no, ɔbɛkora no akɔ daa nkwa mu. Sɛ obi som me a, ma no nni m’akyi, na faako a mewɔ no, ɛhɔ na me somfoɔ nso bɛba; na sɛ obi som me a, m’Agya bɛdi no ni.

Afei me kra ho yera no; na ɛdeɛn na menka? Agya, gye me firi dɔn yi mu! Nanso yei nti na mebaa dɔn yi mu. Agya, hyɛ wo din animuonyam! Ɛnna ɛnne bi firi soro baeɛ: Mahyɛ no animuonyam dada, na mɛhyɛ no bio. Ɛnna nkurɔfokuo a wɔgyina hɔ na wɔteeɛ no kaa sɛ: Aprannaa abom! Ebinom se: Ɔbɔfoɔ ne no kasae. Yesu bua kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me nti na ɛnne yi baeɛ, na mo ntira. Afei ne wiase atemmuo; afei na wɔbɛyi wiase sodifoɔ no hɔ. Na me deɛ, sɛ wɔma me so firi asase so a, mɛtwe nnipa nyinaa maba me nkyɛn. Yei deɛ, ɔka de kyerɛɛ owu ko a ɔrebɛwuo. Nkurɔfokuo no buaa no sɛ: Yɛn deɛ, yɛate no mmara no mu sɛ, Kristo no te hɔ daa; na adɛn na wose: Ɛtwa sɛ wɔma Onipa Ba no soɔ? Hwan ne Onipa Ba yi? Ɛnna Yesu ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Aka hann no berɛ tiaa bi wɔ mo mu. Mowɔ hann no yi, monnante, na esum ammɛto mo; na deɛ ɔnam sum mu no nnim faako a ɔrekorɔ. Mowɔ hann no yi, monnye hann no nni, na moayɛ hann no mma.

Yesu kaa yeinom, na ɔfiri wɔn anim hɔ kɔhuntaeɛ. Na wayɛ saa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bebree wɔ wɔn anim deɛ, nanso wɔannye no anni, na Odiyifoɔ Yesaia asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no aba mu sɛ:
Awurade, hwan na wagye yɛn kaseɛ adie,
na hwan na wɔyii Awurade basa kyerɛɛ no?
Yei nti na wɔantumi annye annie, sɛdeɛ Yesaia kaa bio sɛ:
Wafira wɔn ani,
na wapirim wɔn akoma,
na wɔamfa wɔn ani anhunu,
na wɔamfa wɔn akoma ante aseɛ, na wɔannane wɔn ho
na mansa wɔn yadeɛ.
Yesaia kaa yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhunuu n’animuonyam, na ne ho asɛm na ɔkaeɛ. Na mpanimfoɔ no mu pii nso gyee no diiɛ; nanso Farisifoɔ no nti wɔanka, na wɔantu wɔn amfiri hyiadan mu; ɛfiri sɛ na wɔpɛ nnipa animuonyam sene Nyankopɔn animuonyam.

Na Yesu teaa mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔgye me die no, ɛnyɛ me na ɔgye me die, na ɛyɛ deɛ ɔsomaa me no; na deɛ ɔhu me no, hunu deɛ ɔsomaa me no. Maba wiase sɛ hann, na obiara a ɔgye me die no antena sum mu. Na sɛ obi te me nsɛm na wannye anni a, me deɛ, memmu no atɛn; na mamma sɛ merebɛbu wiase atɛn, na mebaa sɛ merebɛgye wiase. Deɛ ɔmmu me, na ɔnnye me nsɛm no wɔ deɛ ɔbu no atɛn; asɛm a maka no, ɛno ara na ɛbɛbu no atɛn ɛda a ɛdi akyire no mu, ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ ɛnyɛ me na mehyɛɛ me ho mekasaeɛ, na Agya a ɔsomaa me no na ɔhyɛɛ me deɛ menka ne sɛdeɛ menkasa. Na menim sɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ no yɛ daa nkwa. Enti deɛ meka no, sɛdeɛ Agya no aka akyerɛ me no, saa ara na meka.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
